title: NVIDIA cuDF | Nullable Boolean correctness
summary: Merged upstream correctness fix for null-aware Boolean AND and OR logic.
description: Contributed a merged correction to nullable Boolean AND/OR behavior in NVIDIA cuDF. The fix uses existing libcudf null logical operators to preserve known results when the other operand is null.
problem: Nullable Boolean expressions such as True OR null and False AND null were propagating null incorrectly, producing discrepancies with pandas and incorrect filtering results.
role: Open source contributor: investigated the operator semantics, implemented the targeted fix, and added regression tests.
impact: PR #25166 was merged into NVIDIA cuDF main on November 16, 2026, addressing issue #24831.
features: Correct null-aware Boolean AND and OR behavior
Existing bitwise operation behavior preserved
Scalar and reflected operation regression coverage
Boolean truth table cases and DataFrame filtering regression coverage

technologies.Engineering: Nullable Boolean semantics, regression testing, open source review

title: BioBase | Codon Adaptation Index
summary: Merged Python contribution implementing a scientific sequence analysis calculation.
description: Implemented Codon Adaptation Index calculations for BioBase, handling DNA and RNA sequences, codon weights, stop codons, validation, and edge cases.
problem: The library needed a tested Codon Adaptation Index implementation for sequence analysis.
role: Open source contributor: implemented the calculation and unit tests.
impact: PR #15 was merged into BioBase main on November 3, 2025, closing issue #11.
features: Codon Adaptation Index using a geometric mean of codon weights
DNA and RNA input handling
Stop codon and incomplete input handling
Unit tests for normal, invalid, and edge case inputs

technologies.Engineering: Scientific computing, data validation, automated tests

title: SmallBizzWizz
summary: Public website scanner for local service businesses, focused on conversion path friction and actionable repairs.
description: SmallBizzWizz scans a bounded set of public pages and reports observable issues with service request, booking, trust, tracking, mobile, and basic technical signals. Findings are translated into repair guidance without inventing conversion or revenue impact.
problem: Local service businesses may lose contact and quote opportunities because public pages have unclear calls to action or other observable friction; private conversion rates cannot be inferred from public pages.
role: Developer: AI assisted Next.js and TypeScript implementation, URL safety validation, bounded crawl logic, deterministic findings, and public proof fixtures.
impact: Shipped an inspectable public scanner with reproducible synthetic before/after fixtures and explicit evidence limits. No real customer revenue improvement has been claimed.
features: Normalize and check submitted public URLs and network targets
Use bounded redirects, timeouts, and public page fetching
Inspect likely contact, quote, and service pages for observable signals
Present source-backed findings and actionable repair guidance
Publish controlled validation fixtures and limitations

technologies.Engineering: URL validation, network safety checks, bounded crawl, deterministic scanning
